=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/validate_editor_audit.sh:lines 73-77 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: the awk extraction can run past the audit section and treat later summary headings as audit lines when PR comment audit is missing.
  WHY: that produces an unparseable audit and a fail-closed false positive that can block the recovery path.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:lines 1362-1369 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: the per-attempt prompt copy is not checked before appending the nonce trailer.
  WHY: if cp fails, the script can feed codex a truncated or nonce-only prompt.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:lines 1617-1623 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: the changes_lost_detected exit path leaves per-attempt prompt files behind.
  WHY: the files accumulate in the runtime directory, creating minor disk-hygiene debt with no functional impact.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:lines 12820-13179 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: the noop-suspicious recovery sweep paginates PR comments for every PR and can make many extra GitHub API calls.
  WHY: for repositories with many comments or PRs, this can push poll cycles closer to rate limits and increase latency.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:line 6996 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: _FRESH_PUSH_SUPPRESS_SECS changed from 1800 to 3000.
  WHY: this intentionally extends the suppression window from 30 to 50 minutes; operators depending on the old cadence must adjust.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:lines 5713-5720 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: the managed retrigger_review path does not extract head_sha from PR metadata.
  WHY: later stall-recovery code needs the PR head SHA to match in-flight workflow runs, and without it the guard cannot work as intended.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:lines 5829-5862 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: the in-flight review guard passes _rtr_head_sha to jq even though that variable is never populated.
  WHY: the managed path can end up matching empty head_sha values instead of the PR’s actual SHA, weakening the empty-commit defense; the related variable-name inconsistency and unused declaration point to the same copy-paste gap.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:lines ~700-727 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: prompt-size logging happens before sanitize_codex_prompt_file can modify the prompt.
  WHY: the logged size can be larger than what codex actually reads, which can mislead near-cap debugging.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:lines ~5826-5932 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: the in-flight review guard relies on a cached actions-runs blob that may be stale by the time the retrigger_review push happens.
  WHY: a new review_autofix run started after cache priming could be missed, letting an empty commit slip through the defense-in-depth guard.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:lines ~1603-1632 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: _parse_iso8601_to_epoch may fail to parse Z-suffixed timestamps on Python 3.10 and earlier.
  WHY: those timestamps then fall back to None and silently skip the re-anchor path on older runners.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
